arabic text: AAL E AHMED JANGALO MAIN BE RIDA HAIN BE RIDA
english translation text: THE FAMILY OF MUHAMMAD IS BEING PARADED WITHOUT ANY VEIL

arabic text: AAL E AHMED JANGALO MAIN BE RIDA HAIN BE RIDA\nZAINAB O KALSOOM KA HAIY SAR KULA HAI SAR KULA
english translation text: THE FAMILY OF MUHAMMAD IS BEING PARADED WITHOUT ANY VEIL,\nZAINAB AND KULSOOM DO NOT HAVE ANY HEAD COVERING

arabic text: SHIMAR KA KHAIYAM MAIN YUN AAKE CHADAR CHEIYNA\nHUM NA BHULAY GE KABHI BHI\nWA HIJABA KI SADA
english translation text: IN THE WRATH OF SHIMR, THEIR VEILS HAVE BEEN SNATCHED\nWE WILL NOT FORGET THEIR CRIES OF ‘WA HIJABA’

arabic text: SAFAR HAI DUSHWAR ITNA BIBIYA MATAM KUNA\nKHOON AKHON SE RAWA HAI QAFILA SALAR KA
english translation text: THEIR JOURNEY IS SO DIFFICULT, THEIR LAMENTATION IS CONTINUOUS\nTEARS OF BLOOD FLOW CONSTANTLY FROM IMAM SAJJAD’S EYES
